composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. creative_direction: Photograph warm-white linen crossed by a few broad geometric shadows in the lower half. Sparse ocher seam lines add handmade structure without forming a tight grid or readable marks. Reveal weave only near the foreground and soften it upward. Gentle afternoon light creates warm order through fabric, shadow and empty space, keeping the image tactile and unhurried. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
